name: leopard-backless-dress-mirror-selfie
image_purpose: mirror reflection, outfit, bedroom, and warm flash reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic evening bedroom mirror selfie of an approved adult woman in an animal-print dress.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with glossy ombre wavy hair, hazel or green eyes, gold hoop earrings, thin necklace with a small pendant, bangles, and a leopard-print dress with short sleeves and secure back coverage.
prompt.composition_elements: Standing angled profile with head turned toward the mirror, smartphone in right hand, white bed linens, beige knit throw, wooden dresser, bedside table, warm lamp, neutral walls, and realistic flash starburst.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dim cozy evening room with direct camera flash, warm bedside lamp glow, sharp subject and softly softer background.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic mirror selfie, portrait 4:5, accurate reflection, natural skin texture, realistic flash flare and depth.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with glossy ombre waves takes a leopard-print bedroom mirror selfie, wearing a short-sleeve dress with secure back coverage, gold hoops, delicate pendant, and bangles. Use a white bed, beige knit throw, wooden furniture, warm bedside lamp, direct flash starburst, and cozy evening atmosphere. No backless styling or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, backless dress, halter exposure, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, nudity, distorted reflection, extra fingers, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
